Machine learning researcher Nathan Crock maps the future of AI in episode 11 of the KONCRETE podcast with Danny Jones. The early episode catches the field before the chatbot boom made AI a household topic. Crock speaks as a working scientist, not a salesman.

Crock explains where learning algorithms were heading and what problems blocked the road. He and Jones talk about jobs, creativity, and how smart machines might get. The chat mixes real code-level detail with crystal-ball questions about the coming decade. Tech-curious listeners get a grounded look at the AI road ahead, from before the flood.
